status: PROPOSED ACCEPTANCE FRAMEWORK, ALL GATES UNEXECUTED

gates.name: Data/provenance
gates.required_evidence: Raw hashes, schema/completeness, totals/IDs and source/use notes; no invented fields

gates.name: Temporal correctness
gates.required_evidence: Future-perturbation, availability cutoff, one-row/game, event boundaries and exposure audit

gates.name: Statistical oracles
gates.required_evidence: Conjugate moments, score fixtures, exact tiny null and explicit undefined cases

gates.name: Registered adversarial tests
gates.required_evidence: Mandatory applicable attacks execute; missing prerequisites block; changes logged

gates.name: Harness truth isolation
gates.required_evidence: Actual access-denial tests; no truth leakage; labels match estimands

gates.name: Null and power
gates.required_evidence: Independent replicated null/planted/weak/confounded cases; uncertainty and actual counts

gates.name: Calibration separation
gates.required_evidence: Disjoint train/tune/calibration/final groups; held-out family, base rates and scope disclosed

gates.name: Final-data/adaptivity
gates.required_evidence: Frozen family/epoch, persistent record-level exposure registry and atomic unlock; new-ID/renamed-file/restart bypass probes; full family reported

gates.name: Forecast comparison
gates.required_evidence: Identical eligible games/fallbacks; baseline, proper scores, dependence assumptions, coverage

gates.name: NBA event mapping
gates.required_evidence: Exact game/participants/date/outcome and regulation/overtime/cancel mapping; unknowns block

gates.name: Quote normalization
gates.required_evidence: Independent quote-side/unit/tick/quantity fixtures; difference is descriptive, no profit claim

gates.name: Read-only live adapters
gates.required_evidence: Actual permitted metadata/book fetch; stale/empty/error modes, timestamps and raw hashes

gates.name: Authority/immutability
gates.required_evidence: Exact confirmation, retry identity, stale edits, historical evidence and export stability

gates.name: Injection/resource/security
gates.required_evidence: Malicious source/file/URL, bounded tools/jobs/audio, private keys and no order capability

gates.name: Real interface/voice
gates.required_evidence: Actual browser/mic flow, correction/cancel/permissions/error/export; logs and environment

gates.name: Separate review/replay
gates.required_evidence: Reviewer other than author replays exact scope; root causes repaired and rechecked

gates.name: Demo and claims
gates.required_evidence: Every spoken headline linked to actual evidence/mode/limits; recorded fallback labelled

gates.name: Eligibility/submission
gates.required_evidence: Actual event rules/reuse/AI and submission requirements recorded; no concealed preparation
